source: SYNTHESISED, not recorded. No pipeline on this project has a grandchild: every trigger:* job in .gitlab-ci.yml creates a child that triggers nothing further, so dive.depth > 1 had nothing real to record. Ids, sha and timestamps are invented; the shape is the documented one — parent -> trigger:website -> trigger:deploy -> a child carrying deploy:origins. The grandchild is in ANOTHER project (91000001), which is what a multi-project trigger does and what the dive has to route on.
note: The pair of cases is the point: the marker lives in the GRANDCHILD, so depth 1 cannot see it and honestly says `absent`, and depth 2 finds it. `dive.depth` was parsed, documented and read by nothing, so both cases used to give the first answer. The grandchild also lives in another project, so the walk has to take its `project_id` from the downstream pipeline rather than from the watch.
